title: SFHo/FRDM v1.03 real-table audit and occupation closure
source: University of Basel, M. Hempel; Hempel (2015) arXiv:1410.6337; Fiorillo et al. (2025) arXiv:2509.13322v2 App. C.1

provenance.version_note: The four SFHo/FRDM archives are v1.03 data (2012-07-09); manual_v1.04 of 2012-12-19 only added the IUFSU table, so manual and data versions are consistent.

coulomb_electron_input.meaning: Electron-density input passed to sub_coulomb(ne); not a globally valid Yp_tot*nB column.

inferred_ne_over_Ye_density_grid_alignme.interpretation: Observed grid alignment; exact phase-local meaning is not inferred from this identity alone.

full_physical_grid_xi_identity.grid: 81 temperatures x 60 nonzero Yp blocks x 308 physical density rows

closure.definition: xi * nprime_N(T,mstar_N,nu_N) == X_N*nB, where nu_N = mu_nonrel_N - (mstar_N - m_N + SigmaV_N_tot); equivalently the relativistic exponent is [sqrt(p^2+mstar_N^2)-mu_tilde_N]/T with mu_tilde_N = mu_nonrel_N + m_N - SigmaV_N_tot. xi is taken directly from the single-particle table.

xi_composition_identity.definition: xi ?= 1 - (nB - X_n nB - X_p nB)/n0 with n0 = 0.15824150805 fm^-3

closure.validity_scope: The stated validity domain is an empirical subset of the 224 sampled audit cells, not a proof over the continuous EOS grid.

runtime_tests.result: 34/34 passed with SFHO_TABLES_DIR set; no table-dependent test skipped

fixture_regeneration_comparison.interpretation: Differences are quadrature-rounding-level; table inputs and cell indices match.
